id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

typeMetasCache.description: A map of {@link Type#name} to the associated {@link TypeMeta} for quick lookup in the UI.

typeMetasCacheFetched.description: Indicates that TypeMetas cache has been fetched and stored

metadataDepsJson.description:
A map for the {@link TypeMetaDeps} JSON representation for all nodes, keyed by type name
This is a JS Map<string, Object>, so Map.prototype.get() and Map.prototype.set() would be used instead of the object property accessor

editTypeMetaCache.description:
Map only for storing {@link DataFusionUiTypeMeta} in edit mode, mapping from {@link SourceCollection} name to edited DataFusionUiTypeMeta
the map only stores DataFusionUiTypeMeta in intermediate edit state.

pkgExclusionSet.description:
A set of package names that have exclusion config set to true
Set used to filter out cache data for excluded packages
